# `csharp_max_initializer_elements_on_line`

Chop an initializer carrying more than this many elements.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `(not set)`

## Examples

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```ini
csharp_max_initializer_elements_on_line = <value>
```
